in_marathi.name: Sharvansheka
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvansheka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharvansheka is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sharva' meaning lord and 'Ansh' meaning form or manifestation. The name is a combination of these two words, hence it translates to 'Ruler of Gods'.
